body:
Scope: the done-rules extension (§U item 4, row E of the harness guarantee inventory).

Two deliverables from the roadmap row:
1. Synthetic results for unanswered calls — a step that fails mid-flight must never leave an unpaired tool call; an unknown-outcome placeholder is recorded so later history stays usable without blindly retrying an operation whose effect is uncertain.
2. The provider-death completion path (shipped as the item-1 rescue) stated as part of the done contract itself, not as a bolt-on: a turn that lost synthesis with evidence in hand is a first-class done state the contract knows about, not a special case layered on top of it.

Hypothesis to confirm by reading: the contract lives in core/agent/turn_outcome.py + completion_judge.py + evidence_grounding.py, and tool-call pairing lives in loop.py/tool_dispatch.py. Will confirm before editing.
